fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-01-17 at about 21:15, it was reported that cash kept in a drawer valued at around Rs. 25,000 was found missing from a premises near Senthil Garden Main Street. Latha Ammal approached Salem West PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000347. A witness, Rajesh Rajan, reachable on 9000000302, was mentioned in the complaint. Dharani Selvam (mobile 9000000038) was named as a possible person of interest. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00315, as the mobile number 9000000038 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Reported theft occurred while the residents were away for a few hours.
fields.Keywords: property theft, valuables, CCTV, night, main street, witness, mobile number, suspect
